comment: Routes `check-feature-index.mjs` skips when asserting bidirectional coverage (ADR 0043). Every entry names a dashboard route and carries a written reason; an entry naming a route that no longer exists fails the check. Product features must have feature-index entries; platform-level routes like account management are infrastructure, not features, and are exempted here.

exclusions.reason: Platform-level account management route. Not a product feature — administers user settings, profile, and auth — so it has no row in the feature index.
